Master:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Set-Location -LiteralPath 'F:\.codex\worktrees\ecs-relations-worker-3\SomeEngine.Next'
$sourceRecord=Get-Content -LiteralPath 'artifacts/relations-measurements/focused-native-r39/source.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$source=[string]$sourceRecord.SourceCommit
if($sourceRecord.BehaviorExitCode -ne 0 -or $sourceRecord.PublishExitCode -ne 0 -or $sourceRecord.SourceCheckExitCode -ne 0){exit 4}
$control='artifacts/relations-measurements/focused-native-r39'
$series='focused-native-r39'
$publish=Get-Content -LiteralPath 'artifacts/benchmark-queue/6e2ce65a563b48c98da5ebbe9976a6c9/result.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
Write-Output ('PUBLISH_GATE '+$publish.Id+' ExitCode='+$publish.ExitCode+' FinishedAtUtc='+$publish.FinishedAtUtc)
if($publish.ExitCode -ne 0){exit 2}
$reader=Get-Content -LiteralPath 'artifacts/benchmark-queue/c0b4357d7bd14e01b9a3e96f942f8bf2/result.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
if($reader.ExitCode -ne 0){exit 5}
git diff --exit-code $source -- 'src/**/*.cs' 'benchmarks/**/*.cs' 'tests/**/*.cs'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit 3}
$started=[DateTime]::UtcNow
& './benchmarks/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Benchmarks/Submit-Measurements.ps1' -Series $series -CaseId @('finite-small-mask1-oneway','finite-small-mask1-mutual','finite-small-mask8-mutual','default-small-dynamic50','default-small-dynamic90','character-small-hair16-clustered','character-small-hair16-interleaved','updates-small-sparse','threads-small-sparse-parallel','default-middle-dynamic10','default-middle-dynamic50','default-large-dynamic90','finite-large-mask8-mutual','default-large-dynamic50') -Backend NativeAOT -Mode measure -Machine Fixed -QueueScript 'F:\SomeEngine.Next\tools\Invoke-Benchmark.ps1' -Session '01a15090-f5bd-7a12-860a-e214325db5bb' -CollectReports -SourceCommit $source
$reportRoot=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('artifacts/ecs-relations/measurements/focused-native-r39')
$submissions=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reportRoot 'submissions.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$queueSubmission=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reportRoot 'queue-submission.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$manifest=[pscustomobject]@{SourceCommit=$source;Submissions=(Join-Path $reportRoot 'submissions.json');QueueSubmission=(Join-Path $reportRoot 'queue-submission.json');CaseQueueIds=@($submissions.QueueId);AnalysisQueueIds=@($queueSubmission.Reports.QueueId);SubmissionFinishedAtUtc=$queueSubmission.FinishedAtUtc}
$temporary=Join-Path $control 'manifest-ready.json.tmp'
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporary,($manifest|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5))
[IO.File]::Move($temporary,(Join-Path $control 'manifest-ready.json'),$true)
while(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'watcher-ready.json')) -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'native-reader-released.json'))){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20}
$ready=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'watcher-ready.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$readerRelease=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'native-reader-released.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
if($readerRelease.ReaderQueueId -ne $reader.Id -or $readerRelease.SourceCommit -ne $source){exit 6}
$finished=[DateTime]::UtcNow
$record=[pscustomobject]@{SourceCommit=$source;PublishQueueId=$publish.Id;StartedAtUtc=$started;LastCaseSubmittedAtUtc=$queueSubmission.FinishedAtUtc;InitialObservationEndedAtUtc=$finished;WatcherInitialObservationEndedAtUtc=$ready.InitialObservationEndedAtUtc;NativeReaderRelease=$readerRelease;PreparationEndAtUtc=$finished;CaseCount=$submissions.Count;ReaderQueueId=$reader.Id;FinalQueueId=$ready.FinalQueueId}
$record|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'preparation.json') -Encoding utf8
Write-Output ('PREPARATION_END '+($record|ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
exit 0
